blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Aerial visual localization is crucial for autonomous drone navigation in urban environments where GNSS signals are often degraded. Lightweight textureless Level-of-Detail (LoD) city models provide a geometric map alternative to textured assets. Existing silhouette-based methods rely on image-space alignment, which can leave different camera poses indistinguishable and favor incorrect poses when segmentation errors distort the building outlines. We present PlanarCityLoc, which moves beyond silhouette overlap by leveraging the planar geometry of building facades and roofs. Following geometry-aware initialization, we match image-side planar patches to LoD model planes and use the resulting 3D-to-2D correspondences to refine pose with Perspective-n-Point (PnP). The framework uses off-the-shelf geometry and segmentation models without dataset-specific training or fine-tuning. Experiments on UAVD4L-LoDv2 and Swiss-EPFLv2 achieve state-of-the-art localization recall among the evaluated off-the-shelf LoD-based methods. By grounding image-space alignment in 3D planes, PlanarCityLoc enables more accurate aerial localization with lightweight, textureless city maps.
blocks.zh: 在全球导航卫星系统信号往往退化的城市环境中,空中视像本地化对于自主无人机导航至关重要。 轻量级无纹理级(LOD)城市模型提供了一种几何地图替代有纹理资产. 现有的以 silhouette 为主的方法依赖于图像-空间对齐,它可以让不同的相机在分区错误扭曲建筑轮廓时呈现出无法分辨和偏好不正确的相机. 我们介绍PlanarCityLoc,它通过利用建筑外观和屋顶的平面几何来超越了平面重叠。 在几何感知初始化后,我们将图像侧平面补丁与LoD模型平面相匹配,并使用所生成的3D到2D对应来精炼出Perspect-n-Point(PnP)的姿势. 框架采用现成的几何和分块模型,不进行数据集特定训练或微调. 关于UAVD4L-LoDv2和Swiss-EPFLv2的实验,在被评价的现成LoD方法中实现了最先进的本地化召回. PlanarCityLoc通过在3D平面上对地进行图像-空间对接,使得航空定位更加精确,并配有轻量级,无纹理的城市地图.

blocks.en: Aerial visual localization for UAV , defined as estimating the precise 6-Degrees-of-Freedom (6DoF) camera pose from a single image, is essential for operations in GNSS ( GNSS )-denied urban environments [ 37 , 1 ] . Camera pose estimates also support geometry-guided annotation of aerial imagery [ 15 ] and semantic mapping for autonomous landing [ 13 ] . While matching images to textured 3D meshes [ 31 , 39 ] is established, maintaining these assets globally is expensive and privacy-restricted [ 23 ] . Textureless LoD ( LoD ) city models provide a compact geometric reference without storing facade appearance [ 46 , 47 , 26 , 40 , 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 无人驾驶飞行器空中视像定位的定义是从单一图像中估算精确的6-Degrees自由相机(6DoF)外形,对于全球导航卫星系统(GNSS)所拒绝的城市环境中的运作至关重要[37, 1]。 相机的估计还支持了对航空图像的几何-导注 [15] 和语义绘图,用于自主着陆 [13]. 在将图像与纹理化的3D meshes[31,39]相匹配的同时,在全球维护这些资产是昂贵的并限制隐私的[23]. 无纹能LOD(LOD)城市模型提供了一个紧凑的几何参考,而不存储外表[46,47,26,40,12].

blocks.en: One way to bridge the appearance gap between images and textureless maps is to compare their structural projections. LoD-Loc [ 46 ] follows this approach by predicting building wireframes in the query image and aligning them with edges projected from the LoD model. LoD-Loc v2 [ 47 ] instead compares building silhouettes, making alignment applicable to simpler LoD1 geometry ( Fig. 1 (a)). LoD-Loc v3 [ 26 ] uses instance masks to distinguish buildings, reducing ambiguity and broad score plateaus caused by merged semantic silhouettes in dense scenes.
blocks.zh: 弥合图像和无纹理地图相隔的外观差距的一种方法是比较其结构预测. LoD-Loc [46] 遵循了这种方法,在查询图像中预测了构造线框,并与LoD模型所预测的边缘对齐. LoD-Loc v2 [47] 取而代之的是比较了建筑平面图,使对接适用于更简单的LoD1几何(图1 (a)). LoD-Loc v3 [26] 使用实例口罩来区分建筑物,减少在密集场景中由合并的语义 silhouettes引起的模糊和宽分高地.

blocks.en: These silhouette-based objectives still measure agreement in image space. Distinct camera poses can produce similar projections, and disjoint masks yield the same zero intersection-over-union over a range of poses. Segmentation errors introduce a further difficulty. Missing facades, displaced boundaries, or merged building instances change the target silhouette, so an incorrect pose can align better with the predicted mask than the true pose does. Consequently, even a distinct score maximum need not coincide with minimum pose error, as illustrated schematically in Fig. 1 (c). Improving pose accuracy therefore calls for constraints beyond silhouette overlap alone.

blocks.en: Our key observation is that building facades and roofs provide explicit 3D planar patches within LoD models. Off-the-shelf vision models [ 16 , 11 , 38 , 43 , 20 , 28 , 2 ] provide image-side geometry and segmentation without dataset-specific fine-tuning. Building on these cues, we propose PlanarCityLoc . blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are: • We formulate zero-shot LoD -based aerial localization through explicit plane correspondences. • We introduce iterative plane association between image patches and textureless map geometry for robust refinement of the camera pose. • We evaluate on UAVD4L-LoDv2 and Swiss-EPFLv2, achieving state-of-the-art localization recall among the evaluated off-the-shelf LoD-based methods across all four splits, and analyze the contributions of geometric scoring and plane-based refinement through ablations.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Visual localization. Visual localization estimates the 6DoF camera pose relative to a known map. Traditional approaches match local features to a 3D point cloud constructed via Structure-from-Motion [ 31 , 24 ] , pairing feature extractors [ 4 ] with robust matchers [ 30 , 33 , 8 , 9 ] . Hierarchical pipelines [ 29 ] first retrieve relevant images before local feature matching. MeshLoc [ 25 ] localizes directly on 3D meshes, while UAVLoc [ 39 ] uses posed reference images rendered from textured meshes for aerial localization. Render-and-compare approaches [ 42 ] offer another route to aerial pose estimation. MC-Loc [ 35 ] combines pretrained image features, a renderable scene representation, and particle filtering for pose refinement without task-specific training. Maintaining detailed appearance-bearing maps at city scale remains costly. AnyVisLoc [ 45 ] , OrthoLoC [ 5 ] , and OrthoTrack [ 6 ] instead explore localization using overhead imagery and 2.5D surface maps. Our work focuses on textureless LoD geometry, which provides a compact reference without storing facade appearance.
blocks.zh: 视觉本地化. 视觉本地化估计出6DoF相机相对于已知地图的外观. 传统方法将本地特征与通过结构-自动[31,24]所构建的三维点云相匹配,配对特征提取器[4]与强相匹配器[30,33,8,9]. 分级管道[29]先取回相关图像后再进行本地特性匹配. MeshLoc [25] 直接在3D meshes上本地化,而UAVLoc [39] 的用法为空中本地化提供了由有纹理的meshes提供的参考图像。 温和比较方法[42]提供了另一条航道进行空中估计。 MC-Loc [35] 结合了预先训练的图像特征,可渲染的场景表现,以及粒子过滤,以在不经过特定任务训练的情况下进行姿势改进. 按城市规模保持详细的外观图仍然是代价高昂的。 任何VisLoc [45],OrthoLOC [5],和OrthoTrack [6] 相反,利用地上图像和2.5D地表地图探索本地化. 我们的工作重点是无纹理的LOD几何,它提供了一个紧凑的参考,而不存储外观.

blocks.en: LoD-based localization. LoD-Loc [ 46 ] introduced the use of LoD city models for aerial localization through neural wireframe alignment. It predicts building edges in the query image, scores pose hypotheses using projected map wireframes, and refines the estimate through differentiable alignment. LoD-Loc v2 [ 47 ] shifts from wireframes to semantic building silhouettes, supporting simpler LoD1 models through coarse pose search and particle-filter refinement. LoD-Loc v3 [ 26 ] further separates buildings using instance segmentation trained on synthetic aerial imagery. Instance-level alignment reduces the ambiguity of merged semantic masks in dense scenes, but remains sensitive to missing instances, incorrect boundaries, and merged or split predictions. Such errors can displace the overlap maximum from the true pose, even when the score has a distinct peak ( Fig. 1 (c)). Concurrent work, MatchCityLoc [ 7 ] , explores an alternative through matching predicted and rendered surface normals. PlanarCityLoc complements silhouette alignment with explicit 3D plane correspondences. This grounding enables refinement beyond the image-space score peak, leveraging pretrained geometry and segmentation models without dataset-specific training or fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 基于 LoD 本地化. LoD-Loc [46] 引入了LoD城市模型,通过神经线框对接实现航空本地化. 它预测了查询图像中的建筑边缘,分数使用预测的地图线框提出假设,并通过可分化的对齐来完善估计. LoD-Loc v2 [47] 从线框到语义建筑 silhouettes,通过粗糙的姿势来支持更简单的LoD1型号的搜索和粒子过滤器的完善. LoD-Loc v3 [26] 进一步将建筑物分开,使用经过合成航空图像培训的实例分解. 实例级对接降低了合并语义口罩在密集场景中的模糊性,但仍对缺失实例,不正确的边界,以及合并或分化预测敏感. 即使得分有明显的峰值(图1(c))。 同时期工作MatchCityLoc [7],通过匹配预测并制成地表常态来探索替代品. PlanarCityLoc用明确的3D平面对应来补充 silhouette 对齐. 这种地平面使精细化超越了图像-空间分数峰值,在未进行数据集特定培训或微调的情况下,利用了预先训练过的几何和分层模型.

blocks.en: Monocular foundation models. Extracting structured planar patches from a single UAV image requires precise surface geometry and semantic segmentation. Recently, monocular geometry estimation has experienced a paradigm shift due to large-scale foundation models [ 43 , 16 , 11 , 18 ] . Models such as MoGe-2 [ 38 ] can predict metric-scale 3D point maps and detailed surface normals from a single image without any retraining. Similarly, segmentation foundation models like SAM 3 [ 2 ] provide robust zero-shot building masks. The OccuFly benchmark [ 14 ] further highlights the challenges of applying pretrained metric-depth models to aerial imagery across different flight altitudes. We leverage these models to extract geometric and semantic cues from aerial images.
blocks.zh: 独家地基模型. 从单一的无人驾驶飞行器图像中取出结构化的平面补丁需要精确的地表几何和语义分割. 最近,由于大规模地基模型[43,16,11,18],单相位几何估计经历了范式转变. MoGe-2等模型[38]可以从单一图像中预测出公尺尺度的3D点图和详细的地表常态,而无需再培训. 同样地,SAM 3 [2]等分块地基模型提供了坚固的零发式建筑口罩. 《OccuFly》基准[14]进一步突出了对不同飞行高度的航空图像采用经过预先训练的测量深度模型的挑战。 我们利用这些模型从空中图像中提取几何和语义提示。

blocks.en: Plane-based localization. Planes provide structural constraints beyond individual keypoints and have been explored for augmented reality [ 32 ] . In indoor localization, PlanaReLoc [ 44 ] matches query-image and 3D-map planes through learned embeddings. PALMS [ 3 ] uses observed wall geometry and floorplans to initialize indoor particle-filter localization. Related primitive-based methods include Z-FLoc [ 36 ] , which matches lines and circles extracted from monocular reconstructions to floorplans, and outdoor approaches that align semantic or geometric primitives across views [ 22 , 27 ] . These works establish the value of structural primitives, while their use for aerial localization against simplified city models remains less explored. We match facade and roof planes in LoD models to patches predicted from a single UAV image.
blocks.zh: 以飞机为主的本地化. 计划提供了超越个别关键点的结构性制约,并且为扩大现实进行了探索[32]。 在室内局部化中,PlanaReLoc[44]通过所学的嵌入来匹配查询-图像和3D-映射平面. PALMS [3] 使用被观测到的墙壁几何和地平图来初始化室内粒子-过滤器本地化. 相关的原始方法包括:Z-FLoc [36],将从单体重建中提取的线条和圆圈与平面图相匹配;室外方法,将语义或几何原始相通于视线上[22,27]. 这些作品确立了结构原始物的价值,而其用于空中本地化以对抗简化城市模型的探索仍然较少. 我们匹配LOD模型中的外观和屋顶平面 以补丁预言 从单一的无人机图像。

blocks.en: The particle-filter pose and the successive PnP estimates form a candidate set 𝒱 \mathcal{V} . A pose with high silhouette overlap need not have the most accurate geometric alignment, while prediction noise can lower the overlap of a well-aligned pose. We therefore combine eight complementary criteria: composite alignment score, mask recall, mask IoU, edge alignment, depth correlation, normal error, reprojection error, and matched-plane centroid distance. The composite alignment score follows the additive form in Eq. 4 , but uses rendered normal-map edges to also capture internal facade and roof structure. Final selection balances all eight criteria instead of maximizing the composite score alone.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experiment Settings and Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置和基线

blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate on the UAVD4L-LoDv2 and Swiss-EPFLv2 query splits [ 47 , 26 ] , inherited from UAVD4L-LoD and Swiss-EPFL [ 46 ] , respectively. These dataset extensions introduce LoD1 maps while retaining the original queries. Each query benchmark has two splits: in-Traj. and out-of-Traj. for UAVD4L-LoDv2, and in-Place and out-of-Place for Swiss-EPFLv2. Swiss-EPFL imagery and poses originate from CrossLoc [ 41 ] . Our main experiments use LoD3 for UAVD4L-LoDv2 and LoD2 for Swiss-EPFLv2 unless stated otherwise. The released UAVD4L-LoDv2 priors are sensor-derived, whereas Swiss-EPFLv2 priors were synthesized from ground truth by the benchmark authors [ 46 ] .
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们评价UAVD4L-LoDv2和Swiss-EPFLv2的查询分拆[47,26],分别由UAVD4L-LoD和瑞士-EPFL[46]继承. 这些数据集扩展在保留原始查询的同时引入了LoD1地图. 每个查询基准有两个分块:为UAVD4L-LoDv2的in-Traj.和out-traj.;为瑞士-EPFLv2的in-Place和out-Place. Swiss-EPFL图像和外形发自CrossLoc [41]. 我们的主要实验使用LoD3用于UAVD4L-LoDv2,LoD2用于瑞士-EPFLv2,除非另有说明. 所释放的UAVD4L-LoDv2前传是传感器衍生的,而瑞士-EPFLv2前传则由基准作者从地上真实地合成 [46].

We use rasterized map renderings with ground-truth-rendered masks for LoD-Loc v2 and LoD-Loc v3, and additionally evaluate LoD-Loc v2 with SAM 3 [ 2 ] predictions. These variants contrast ideal masks with general-purpose predictions for localization.

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. Following prior work [ 47 , 26 ] , we report median translation and rotation errors, and recall at 2m–2 ∘ , 3m–3 ∘ , and 5m–5 ∘ . A query is recalled when both errors are strictly below the corresponding thresholds.

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation Results
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价结果

blocks.en: Quantitative results. We report the results in Tab. 1 . PlanarCityLoc outperforms the evaluated prior off-the-shelf LoD-based methods in recall across all four splits and all three thresholds. Explicit plane correspondences substantially improve the particle-filter estimates on both UAVD4L-LoDv2 splits and Swiss-EPFLv2 out-of-Place. Textured-map UAVLoc remains stronger, benefiting from richer appearance cues unavailable in textureless geometry.
blocks.zh: 量化结果。 我们在Tab报告结果。 1. PlanarCityLoc在所有4个拆分和所有3个阈值中,在召回中超过了先前评估的现成LOD方法。 明确的平面对应大大改进了UAVD4L-LoDv2分片和瑞士-EPFLv2出地的粒子过滤器估计. 纹理图UAVLoc仍然更强大,受益于无纹理几何中无法提供的更丰富的外观提示.

blocks.en: Swiss-EPFLv2 in-Place is more challenging for plane refinement, with 2m–2 ∘ recall changing from 24.9% to 20.6%. This split has fewer visible map patches and a larger imbalance between predicted and rendered patch counts than out-of-Place, consistent with less reliable plane associations. Refinement also produces fewer successful PnP proposals, and candidate selection sometimes favors an inaccurate update. These observations highlight the importance of sufficiently rich, consistent planar evidence.

blocks.en: Refinement stages. The staged results in Tab. 1 and the examples in Fig. 4 show how coarse image-space alignment provides a useful initialization for explicit 3D refinement. Plane-based proposals substantially improve three splits, showing the complementary value of geometric correspondences beyond silhouette scoring.
blocks.zh: 完善阶段. 所上演的 Tab. 1 和 Fig. 4 中的例子显示了粗糙的图像-空间对接如何为清晰的3D改进提供了有用的初始化. 基于平面的建议大大地改进了三分法,显示出了几何函式的互补价值,超出了平面分数.

blocks.en: Pose selection. Table 3 compares selection rules on identical candidate pools. Equal-weight rank aggregation gives the lowest median rotation error on both UAVD4L-LoDv2 splits and the lowest median translation error on out-of-Traj., while maintaining near-best strict recall. No single alignment cue consistently gives the best pose. These results support balancing complementary criteria through ranks, which avoid dependence on their different numerical scales without learning aggregation weights.

blocks.en: Sensitivity to prior pose noise. We investigate sensitivity to the initial pose by increasing translation and orientation noise, with search ranges expanded to match the tested perturbations ( Fig. 5 ). Larger perturbations lead to higher final errors. Nevertheless, plane refinement reduces both translation and rotation errors relative to particle filtering at every tested noise level, measured by the mean of the split-wise medians. The experiment tests refinement under substantial initial uncertainty beyond the released priors.

blocks.en: 4.5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.5 限制

blocks.en: PlanarCityLoc requires a useful coarse pose and sufficient reliable plane correspondences. Performance depends on the accuracy of the foundation-model predictions and the quality of the LoD geometry. In particular, approximating complex building shapes with LoD1 can make plane assignment noisier and reduce localization accuracy. The multi-stage pipeline combines neural predictions with repeated rendering and cannot yet operate onboard in real time without further optimization. Future work targets fast initialization and hardware-aware real-time optimization.
blocks.zh: PlanarCityLoc需要一种有用的粗糙姿势和足够的可靠的平面通信. 性能取决于地基模型预测的准确性和LOD几何的质量. 尤其是,与LoD1相近的复杂建筑形状可以使平面分配噪声器并降低本地化精度. 多相管结合了神经预测和重复渲染,如果不进一步优化,仍然不能实时在机上运行. 未来工作的目标是快速初始化和硬件意识实时优化.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented PlanarCityLoc, which grounds silhouette-based aerial localization in the 3D planar geometry of lightweight, textureless city models. By establishing plane correspondences and refining pose through PnP, our method achieves state-of-the-art localization recall among the evaluated off-the-shelf LoD-based methods without dataset-specific training. Our experiments demonstrate the value of planes for further improving pose estimation beyond image-space alignment. Effective refinement requires sufficient reliable plane correspondences. The current multi-stage pipeline is not yet real-time, motivating more efficient initialization and hardware-aware optimization for onboard deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了PlanarCityLoc, 它将基于 silhouette 的空中局部化 在3D平面几何 轻量级,无纹理的城市模型。 通过建立平面通信并通过PnP来精炼外形,我们的方法在不经过数据集特定培训的情况下,在评估的现成LOD方法中实现了最先进的本地化召回. 我们的实验显示飞机的价值 将进一步改进布局估计 超越图像空间对齐。 有效改进需要足够的可靠的飞机通信。 目前的多阶段管道还不是实时的,激发出更高效的初始化和硬件意识优化以进行机上部署.

blocks.en: Appendix B Computational Complexity
blocks.zh: 附录B 计算 复杂性

blocks.en: Our coarse stage follows the image-space search paradigm of prior work [ 47 , 26 ] . PlanarCityLoc then introduces explicit 3D constraints through plane correspondences and PnP, avoiding another dense search over pose hypotheses.

blocks.en: On UAVD4L-LoDv2 in-Traj. and out-of-Traj., the rendering, matching, and PnP computations used in refinement take an average of 0.52 and 0.48 s per query on an NVIDIA H100 NVL. blocks.en: Mean wall-clock latency is 6.42 s per query on UAVD4L-LoDv2 in-Traj. (H100 NVL) and 8.75 s on Swiss-EPFLv2 in-Place (A40), including image loading and transfers but excluding one-time initialization.

blocks.en: On the two UAVD4L-LoDv2 splits, refinement and final selection improve joint 2 m–2 ∘ localization recall from 36.0% to 75.4% and from 60.8% to 80.6%, respectively ( Tab. A1 ). This demonstrates the value of complementing coarse image-space alignment with correspondence-driven 3D pose updates.

blocks.en: Appendix D Extended Results
blocks.zh: 附录D

blocks.en:
Per-split breakdowns. We report the complete staged evaluation in Tab. A1 .
This evaluation details the performance of the cost volume, particle filter, and our plane matching approach across all benchmark splits.
The full-split results show substantial gains from plane matching on both UAVD4L-LoDv2 splits and Swiss-EPFLv2 out-of-Place, supporting the use of 3D constraints beyond silhouette agreement.
We also report the full-split UAVD4L-LoDv2 LoD1 ablation and both Swiss-EPFLv2 splits with LoD2 maps.
Swiss-EPFLv2 in-Place is more challenging for refinement ( Tab. A1 ). Figure A1 compares scene examples and planar support. At the particle-filter pose, this split has fewer rendered map patches and a larger predicted-to-rendered patch-count ratio than out-of-Place. The examples contrast sparse building coverage and construction areas with multi-building scenes. Lower map support and greater patch-count imbalance suggest more challenging image-to-map plane association.
blocks.zh:
每分分分出分出. 我们以 Tab. A1 报告完整的分阶段评估。
本评价详细介绍了成本量的性能,粒子过滤,以及我们在所有基准分数中的平面比对方法.
完全分解的结果显示,在UAVD4L-LoDv2分机和瑞士-EPFLv2出站点上进行平面相配有很大收益,支持使用超过硅胶协议的3D限制.
我们还报告全相分离的UAVD4L-LoDv2 LoD1通缩图,以及瑞士-EPFLv2用LoD2地图分出.
瑞士-EPFLv2 in-Place更具有改进挑战性(Tab. A1.). 图A1比较了场景实例和平面支持. 在粒子过滤器的姿势下,这种分解的映射补丁数量较少,预想到的补丁计分比也比出地平分要多. 这些例子将建筑覆盖面和建筑区与多建筑场景形成对比。 较低的地图支持和更大的补丁计数不平衡表明图像到地图平面关联更具挑战性.

Right: full-split distributions at the particle-filter pose. Boxes show interquartile ranges, lines show medians, and whiskers show the full range. The ratio axis is logarithmic.

blocks.en:
Plane extraction against LoD primitives. Figure A2 compares LoD planes rendered from the mesh with planes segmented from predicted normals.
LoD planes follow the mesh tessellation and remain largely insensitive to the normal-consistency threshold.
In contrast, predicted planes depend on normal and depth consistency as well as minimum region size.
Fine settings can fragment a facade, while coarse settings can merge distinct surfaces. The examples illustrate this trade-off in the resulting planar representation.
blocks.zh:
飞机对LOD原始人进行提取. 图A2比较了网状的LOD平面和从预测的平面分出平面的平面.
LoD平面跟随网状突起并基本保持对常态一致性阈值不敏感.
相形之下,所预测的平面取决于正常和深度的一致性以及最小的区域大小.
精细的设置可以将外观分解出来,而粗糙的设置可以将不同的表面相融合出来. 这些例子表明,在由此而来的平面表述中,这种取舍。

blocks.en: Figure A2 : Plane extraction qualitative comparison. LoD primitives against predicted plane extractions. Patch granularity varies with normal consistency and minimum region size. RQ and PQ denote Recognition Quality and Panoptic Quality, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图A2:飞机提取质量比较。 LOD原始人对抗预测的平面取出. 补丁颗粒性随正常的一致性和最小区域大小而变化. RQ和PQ分别表示识别质量和泛光学质量.

blocks.en:
Failure cases. Planar refinement requires useful image-to-map alignment. Figure A3 illustrates initialization failures. Off-the-shelf segmentation under domain shift can miss small buildings, misclassify lakes or parking lots, or produce noisy masks, favoring incorrect cost-volume hypotheses.
Disjoint query and rendered masks then supply no overlap-based distinction between nearby hypotheses, weakening the initialization for plane matching.
Beyond pure segmentation errors, matching can also degrade due to weak building visibility, ambiguous facade normals from repetitive architecture, or temporal mismatches between outdated LoD geometry (e.g., ground artifacts modeled as buildings) and the true UAV capture.
When geometric and mask cues disagree strongly, reliable confidence estimation is needed to avoid incorrect pose updates.
blocks.zh:
失败案例。 计划改进需要有用的图像到地图对齐. 图A3显示初始化失败。 域名转移下的现成分拆可能会错过小型建筑,错分类湖泊或停车场,或者产生吵闹的口罩,倾向于不正确的成本量假设.
断开的查询和提供口罩,然后不提供相邻假说之间基于重叠的区分,削弱了平面相配的初始化.
除了纯分化错误外,相配还可以由建筑能见度弱,重复建筑的外观常态模棱两可,或者过时的LoD几何(例如以建筑为模型的地上文物)与真实的无人机捕获之间的时间不匹配而降解.
当几何和口罩提示有强烈的分歧时,需要可靠的信心估计来避免不正确的姿势更新.

blocks.en: Figure A3 : Mask segmentation examples. Query images and predicted masks illustrate incomplete building coverage and non-building regions included by off-the-shelf segmentation. Such errors can weaken coarse alignment and the planar evidence available for refinement.
blocks.zh: 图A3:面具分化实例。 查询图像和预测口罩可以说明建筑物覆盖不完整和由现成分块法包括的非建筑区域. 这种错误会削弱粗细的校正和可供改进的平面证据。

Coarse scoring components. Table A2 demonstrates the impact of different geometric cues during coarse search and particle filtering.
Relying solely on mask intersection-over-union (IoU) provides a weak signal under occlusion.
Edges add boundary constraints, while depth helps distinguish hypotheses with similar silhouettes but different spatial configurations. Combining all three cues gives the highest strict recall on both subsets, supporting their complementary role in initialization.

blocks.en:
Plane extraction criteria. Table A3 explores the logic for grouping predicted surface normals into planar primitives.
Grouping by normal consistency alone captures facades but can merge adjacent surfaces with similar orientations.
Depth continuity helps separate these surfaces, but alone does not distinguish their orientation. Combining both criteria gives the highest strict recall and lowest median translation error on both subsets, while normal consistency alone remains competitive at looser thresholds.
blocks.zh:
飞机取出标准。 表A3探索了将预测的地表常态分组为平面原始态的逻辑.
通过正常一致性单独分组可以捕捉外观,但可以将相邻的表面与相近的方向相融合.
深度连续性有助于这些表面的分离,但单靠它并不能区分它们的取向. 将这两个标准结合起来,可以使两个子集中最严格的召回和中位数的翻译出错,而正常一致性本身在更宽松的阈值上仍然具有竞争力.

blocks.en: Table A3: Plane extraction criteria. Normal and depth consistency for predicted and rendered planes. Matched 100-query UAVD4L-LoDv2 subsets (in-Traj. / out-of-Traj.). Joint recalls (%) and median errors. Best/second-best values are bold/underlined.
blocks.zh: 表A3: 飞机提取标准。 预测和制造飞机的正常和深度一致性。 匹配了100克的UAVD4L-LoDv2子集(in-Traj./off-traj.). 联合回顾(%)和中位差错。 最佳/次最佳值为粗体/下行.

blocks.en:
PnP matching strategy. Table A4 evaluates our sequential alignment criteria during PnP optimization.
Overlap voting accommodates fragmented image patches, while centroid consistency establishes more localized correspondences. Applying both matchers sequentially combines these complementary cues and gives the highest strict recall on both subsets. Overlap-only matching remains stronger at some looser out-of-Traj. thresholds.
blocks.zh:
PnP配对策略. 表A4在PnP优化期间评价我们的相继调整标准.
重叠投票可以容纳零碎的图像补丁,而百分数一致性则会建立更本地化的对应. 相继应用两个相匹配符将这些互补的提示组合起来,并在两个子集上给予最严格的召回. 在离特拉杰更远的门槛值上,只重叠匹配仍然更强.

blocks.en: Table A4: PnP matching strategies. Overlap, centroid, and sequential correspondences. Matched 100-query UAVD4L-LoDv2 subsets (in-Traj. / out-of-Traj.). Joint recalls (%) and median errors. Best/second-best values are bold/underlined.
blocks.zh: 表A4:PnP相配策略. 重叠、中间机器人和相继通信。 匹配了100克的UAVD4L-LoDv2子集(in-Traj./off-traj.). 联合回顾(%)和中位差错。 最佳/次最佳值为粗体/下行.

blocks.en: Figure A4 : Comprehensive prior noise evaluation. Joint recall and median errors under synthetic pose perturbations on UAVD4L-LoDv2, using 300 queries per split and expanded search ranges. Native-prior points are separate references on the same queries.
blocks.zh: 图A4:综合前置噪声评价。 UAVD4L-LODv2合成下联合召回和中位误差,使用每分取和扩展搜索范围300个查询. 土著-先入为主点是同一查询的单独参考。

blocks.en: Figure A5 : Visual examples of map completeness. Overlays of rendered LoD geometry for the intact map and representative removal conditions. Groups are selected by projected area, not physical building volume.
blocks.zh: 图A5:地图完整性的视觉实例。 为完好无缺的地图和具有代表性的去除条件填充LOD几何。 组别按预测面积选择,而非物理建筑体积.

blocks.en: Outlier rejection. PnP-RANSAC [ 10 ] rejects inconsistent correspondences and refines the pose on the inliers. Updating correspondences as the pose changes allows subsequent iterations to use the improved image-to-map alignment.
blocks.zh: 外部拒绝。 PnP-RANSAC [10] 拒绝不一致的函文,并完善了出入口上的姿势. 随着姿势的改变来更新信件,可以使后继的迭代使用改进后图像到映射的对齐.

blocks.en: Pose selection. Reprojection and centroid errors are obtained from PnP correspondences and are not computed for the particle-filter candidate. For each criterion, candidates without a measurement rank below those with valid measurements. Equal criterion values receive average ranks. Equal aggregate ranks retain the earlier candidate, with the particle-filter estimate considered first. These conventions also apply to the full-split pose-selection comparison in the main paper.
blocks.zh: 派斯选. 从PnP通信中获取了再预测和百分数误差,而不是为粒子过滤器候选人计算。 对于每项标准,没有衡量标准的候选人排名低于有有效衡量标准的候选人。 同等标准值得到平均排名。 相等的总排名保留了较早的候选人,首先考虑粒子过滤估计。 这些公约也适用于主要文件中的完全分开的姿势选择比较。

blocks.en:
Building segmenters. Table A5 compares the impact of the upstream vision model, with visual examples shown in Fig. A3 .
While the geometry prediction (MoGe-2) remains fixed, swapping the SAM3 [ 2 ] mask module for EoMT [ 19 ] severely degrades performance.
Reliable building masks are therefore important for both coarse alignment and subsequent plane matching.
blocks.zh:
建筑分会. 表A5比较了上游视觉模型的影响,视觉实例如图. A3.
虽然几何预测(MoGe-2)仍然固定,但将SAM3 [2]口罩模块换为EOMT [19] 严重地降低性能.
因此,可靠的建筑口罩对于粗糙的对接和随后的飞机相配都很重要.

blocks.zh: 表A5:建筑分机. SAM 3和EOMT配有固定的MoGe-2 VIT-S几何. 匹配了100克的UAVD4L-LoDv2子集(in-Traj./off-traj.). 联合回顾(%)和中位差错。 最佳/次最佳值为粗体/下行.

blocks.en: Appendix F Robustness Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录F 分析

blocks.en:
Sensitivity to prior pose noise. We summarize median pose error against injected prior noise in Fig. A4 .
We evaluate synthetic priors on 300 fixed queries per UAVD4L-LoDv2 split. Translation and angular components are uniformly perturbed within bounds of 10, 20, or 30 meters/degrees, with pitch and roll limited to ± 5 ∘ \pm 5^{\circ} . Search ranges are expanded to accommodate the increased uncertainty. Native-prior results are shown separately.
blocks.zh:
对前作出声的敏感性. 在图A4中,我们总结了中位数对先前注入的噪音造成的错误。
我们评估每个UAVD4L-LoDv2拆分300个固定查询的合成前科. 翻译和角构件在10,20,或30米/度的界限内均被统一扰动,投出和滚出限制为± 5\pm 5\circ}. 搜索范围被扩大,以适应增加的不确定性. 土生土长的结果单独显示。

blocks.en: Larger initial errors reduce localization accuracy. Plane-based refinement nevertheless lowers median translation and rotation errors relative to particle filtering at every tested perturbation level. At the largest offsets, absolute recall remains low, highlighting the importance of a useful initialization even when 3D constraints improve the estimate.
blocks.zh: 较大的初始错误会降低本地化精度. 然而,与每个经测试的扰动水平的粒子过滤相比,基于飞机的改进降低了中位翻译和旋转误差。 在最大程度上,绝对召回率仍然很低,突出表明即使在3D限制改善估计数时,还是有必要进行有益的初始化。

blocks.en: Sensitivity to map completeness.
blocks.zh: 对地图完整性的敏感性。

blocks.en: Table A6: Map completeness. Matched 100-query UAVD4L-LoDv2 subsets (in-Traj. / out-of-Traj.). Groups of nearby mesh surfaces are removed by projected area. Queries without sufficient groups retain the intact map. Joint recalls (%) and median errors. Best/second-best values are bold/underlined.
blocks.zh: 表A6:地图完整性。 匹配了100克的UAVD4L-LoDv2子集(in-Traj./off-traj.). 附近的网状地表群被按预计区域清除. 没有足够组的查询保留了完整的地图. 联合回顾(%)和中位差错。 最佳/次最佳值为粗体/下行.

blocks.en:
We investigate the sensitivity of our pipeline to missing structures in the LoD model in Tab. A6 .
For each frame, we selectively remove a visible mesh-derived group of nearby surfaces before rendering the map prior.
Removal size is defined by projected area at the initial pose, with each group approximating a visible structure rather than a labeled building instance.
Removing small or medium groups has mixed effects, while removing the largest group lowers strict recall on both splits. This supports the importance of large visible structures as geometric anchors for localization. Figure A5 visualizes these scenarios.
blocks.zh:
我们调查我们管道对塔布LOD模型中缺失结构的敏感性. A6 (英语).
对于每个框架,我们有选择地取出一组可见的网状出自相邻的地表,然后将地图做到前面.
移除大小按初始位置的预测面积来定义,每组近似可见的结构,而不是被标注的建筑实例.
消除中小群体有好坏参半的效果,而消除最大的群体则会降低对两种分裂的严格召回。 这支持了大型可见结构作为几何锚地对本地化的重要性. 图A5可视化这些情景.

blocks.en: Appendix G Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录G 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: PlanarCityLoc depends on reliable coarse initialization. Poor masks or inaccurate GPS priors can lead to incorrect alignment that planar refinement cannot recover ( Fig. A3 ). Localization also degrades with incomplete or poorly modeled LoD geometry ( Tab. A6 ). Better upstream predictions and robust initialization could mitigate these limitations. Temporal filtering could disambiguate repetitive structures through motion cues. Efficient initialization and hardware-aware optimization remain necessary for onboard real-time operation.
blocks.zh: PlanarCityLoc依赖于可靠的粗细初始化. 面罩差或GPS前科不准确可能导致不正确的对接,使平面图的改进无法恢复(图A3)。 局部化还以不完整或模型差的LOD几何来降解(Tab. A6.). 更好的上游预测和强有力的初始化可以减轻这些限制。 时间过滤可通过运动提示使重复结构分解. 有效的初始化和硬件意识优化仍然是机上实时运行的必要条件.

blocks.en: Appendix H Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 附录H 道德考虑

blocks.en:
Geographic bias and reliability. Our zero-shot evaluation is geographically constrained to specific urban environments, and performance may vary across different architectural styles.
Lacking hard accuracy guarantees, the system requires rigorous fallbacks before deployment in safety-critical autonomous flights.
blocks.zh:
地理偏差与可靠性. 我们的零镜头评价在地理上受特定城市环境的限制,不同建筑风格的表现可能有所不同.
该系统缺乏硬准确性保证,需要在安全关键自主飞行部署前进行严格的回落。

blocks.en: Privacy and data usage. Public datasets and textureless maps do not eliminate privacy risks. Query images and pretrained models may contain sensitive information, and downstream use must respect applicable data and model terms. Swiss-EPFL map data are provided by the Federal Office of Topography swisstopo.
blocks.zh: 隐私和数据使用。 公共数据集和无纹理地图并不能消除隐私风险. 查询图像和预先训练过的模型可能包含敏感信息,下游的使用必须尊重适用的数据和模型术语. 瑞士-EPFL地图数据由联邦地形测量办公室提供。

blocks.en: Dual-use potential. Although intended for civilian inspection, aerial localization can enable surveillance and requires safeguards against misuse.
blocks.zh: 双重用途潜力。 空中本地化虽然是为了进行民事检查,但能够进行监视,需要防止滥用。
